import tkinter as tk from tkinter import ttk import pyperclip import pyautogui import time class CodeSidebar: def __init__(self, root): self.root = root self.root.title("CodeSidebar") # Position window at top right screen_width = self.root.winfo_screenwidth() self.root.geometry(f"280x700+{screen_width - 300}+50") self.root.attributes('-topmost', True) self.root.attributes('-alpha', 0.95) # Simple styling style = ttk.Style() style.theme_use('clam') # Search self.search_var = tk.StringVar() self.search_var.trace_add("write", self.filter_snippets) tk.Entry(root, textvariable=self.search_var).pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=5) # Tabs self.notebook = ttk.Notebook(root) self.notebook.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=5, pady=5) self.tab_html = ttk.Frame(self.notebook) self.tab_js = ttk.Frame(self.notebook) self.notebook.add(self.tab_html, text="HTML") self.notebook.add(self.tab_js, text="JS") self.buttons = [] self.setup_html() self.setup_js() def paste_snippet(self, text): try: pyperclip.copy(text) pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'tab') time.sleep(0.2) pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'v') except Exception as e: print(f"Paste error: {e}") def create_btn(self, parent, label, code): btn = tk.Button(parent, text=label, command=lambda: self.paste_snippet(code), anchor="w") btn.pack(fill="x", pady=2, padx=5) self.buttons.append((btn, label)) def filter_snippets(self, *args): query = self.search_var.get().lower() for btn, label in self.buttons: if query in label.lower(): btn.pack(fill="x", pady=2, padx=5) else: btn.pack_forget() def setup_html(self): items = [("Div", "
"), ("Span", ""), ("Input", "")] for l, c in items: self.create_btn(self.tab_html, l, c) def setup_js(self): items = [("Log", "console.log();"), ("Func", "function() {}")] for l, c in items: self.create_btn(self.tab_js, l, c) if __name__ == "__main__": root = tk.Tk() app = CodeSidebar(root) root.mainloop()
